item.text: {"summary":"The draft is publishable in structure and target alignment, with only minor evidentiary tightening needed around the upward adjustment and interval calibration.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"update","severity":"warning","summary":"The +2.3 pp automation/compliance drift adjustment is directionally plausible but not strongly tied to cited Iowa-specific or CMS evidence.","actionRequested":"Either cite concrete evidence supporting continued Iowa improvement through August 2026 or describe the +2.3 pp as a subjective/damped judgment rather than evidence-driven movement."},{"rubricItem":"interval","severity":"warning","summary":"The interval references realized dispersion and six-month uncertainty, but the exact widening from observed changes to the 63.5-91.5 bounds is only loosely specified.","actionRequested":"Add one sentence explaining how the 14.5 pp lower and 13.5 pp upper half-widths were chosen from the observed adjacent-change volatility and horizon risk."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Clarify whether the February 2026 value is definitely an original first-print row rather than an updated submission, since the source context mentions updated February data.","The resolver, unit, first-print policy, dataPointId, point, interval, and JSON fields are coherent with the canonical target."]}
